title: Rabbi Abba bar Yaakov
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as a student of Rabbi Yochanan and says he always speaks in his name: [Ketubot 77a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.77a.6), [Gittin 59a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.59a.15-16), [Bava Metzia 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.38b.4) (where the name is given as Rabbi Abba son of Rabbi Yaakov), Yerushalmi Sheviit ch. 1 halakha 1, [Terumot, end of ch. 5](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Terumot.5.3.5), Kilayim ch. 7 halakha 4, [Maaserot 1:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Maasrot.1.2.2), [Maaser Sheni 1:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Maaser_Sheni.1.1.12), [Chagigah, end of ch. 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Chagigah.1.8.14), [Yevamot 2:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Yevamot.2.12.2), Sotah ch. 8 halakha 2, [Bava Metzia 3:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Bava_Metzia.3.4.2).

So too we find him speaking in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak Rova ([Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.6.1.19)), but we do not find that he spoke with them directly. As for what we find in [Sanhedrin 27a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.27a.21)–[Sanhedrin 27b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.27b.3), that he was in Babylonia, where it says there that Bar Chama killed a person and the Exilarch said to Rav Abba bar Yaakov, 'Go out and examine it,' and he wished to find him liable while Rav Papi found a merit for him, Hyman considers it clear that it should read Rav Acha bar Yaakov, as in the reading of Dikdukei Soferim, since Rav Papi lived later, as a pupil of Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Sanhedrin names Rav Abba bar Yaakov and continues with Rav Papi’s intervention. Hyman proposes Rav Acha because of the chronology. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=43&lang=en) cites the episode under Abba and also records the attribution to Rabbi Yitzchak Rova.
